description: This source file contains fuzz testing code for the BackoffEntrySerializer component in the net namespace, including functions for deserialization, serialization, and testing of BackoffEntry objects using protobuf inputs.

classes.name: ProtoTranslator
classes.description: A helper class to translate protobuf input into BackoffEntry parameters and related objects.

classes.name: MockClock
classes.description: A mock implementation of base::TickClock for testing purposes.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::policy
methods.description: Returns a BackoffEntry::Policy object derived from protobuf input.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::parse_time
methods.description: Returns a base::Time object parsed from protobuf input.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::parse_time_ticks
methods.description: Returns a base::TimeTicks object parsed from protobuf input.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::serialize_time
methods.description: Returns a base::Time object for serialization from protobuf input.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::now_ticks
methods.description: Returns a base::TimeTicks object representing current time from protobuf input.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::serialized_entry
methods.description: Converts protobuf serialized entry to base::Value if possible.

methods.name: TestDeserialize
methods.description: Tests deserialization and reserialization properties of BackoffEntry.

methods.name: TestSerialize
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization consistency of BackoffEntry.
